fields.description: The Element at Sobha One is a residential tower with one- to four-bedroom apartments. Its plans combine balconies with layouts ranging from compact one-bedroom homes to larger family residences with service rooms. The tower belongs to the Sobha One setting; its own drawings and launch terms should be used instead of those for the original Sobha One towers.

overview: One-bedroom Type A has a separate powder room and balcony, while larger apartments add storage or a maid’s room. The four-bedroom Type A shown in the original pack is an apartment; unrelated duplex measurements from broker summaries are not substituted.
research.locationNote: Sobha One, Dubai, as described in the developer’s own project materials. No nearby district is substituted for the project address.
research.priceNote: The own developer page fetched on 31 October 2026 advertises AED 1,830,000 from, subject to inventory availability. This is a published guide, not a checked available unit, valuation or binding offer. Other historical launch advertisements may use a different price or unit mix.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder publishes 10% booking, 50% construction and 40% handover. House Finder instead advertises 20/40/40. Both are secondary summaries; no current developer-issued unit schedule was available.
research.handoverNote: The FY 2025 developer investor snapshot lists 2028; Property Finder lists December 2029. A revised current tower-specific completion document was not located. Handover remains on request until that conflict is resolved.
